items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: he says well before you go back, I’m going to start a band, me and Michael White are going to start this band, just come up and see if you want to deal with it.

ctx.x: Okay. Because we kind of skipped over — I wanted to talk about the Fourth Way. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

Oh boy. Well that’s another reason I stayed on the West Coast so long. Because actually after I came out here with Dionne and everything and I was in L.A. — L.A. I couldn’t really hang because L.A. is more like a recording industry and I’ve always played live music. So we were going to leave L.A. actually and go back to New York, when the baby was like a few months old. But Mike Nock, who was the piano player with Dionne, he had moved out to the West Coast. He had left Dionne’s band before I did. And he went to…
You’d established yourself in the area. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
